notes.title: v0.32.9 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Thru Thrillers,

Thank you everyone who gave feedbacks to us. We are continuing to update games.

[b]Basket Game[/b]
We've added a little basketball game to the trash can. We noticed that you like to throw the cans. Depending on how far you throw them, you can earn up to $5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/ef1b0426d17f5092a8e66bf11a73c570a65fd19a.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/dff47a6434badbafcb8b7e8f1b240f2c6efb961a.png[/img]

[b]Improvement[/b]
-Product images are now on the box.
-New characters
-Pizza,Burger,Popcorn boxes per stack is increased to 20.
-Right-clicking on any money in the cash register takes back the last money
-Quit button replaced with Save&Quit.
-Drink machine has green indicators and you can see drink names anymore


[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]
-Burned products cant throw to garbage
-Fixed an issue where drink glasses were empty when the game was loaded
-Fixed box shelf bug on game load.

[b]Streamer[/b]
-Improvements made regarding to reports

Add To Wishlist !

notes.title: v0.32 Update
notes.notes:
We are here with a new version with many updates. Thanks to all the Thru Thriller's who played our game and gave feedback.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Time Management[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/6983ca3693e9afffb7679f0bf4af0b6d2a2f81ff.png[/img]

We heard that you wanted time to organize your shop and we got to work right away.

Morning: Time doesn't start until you open the shop. 

Night: at 11 o'clock all customers leave your shop. If you want you can stay the night shift and organize your shop. 


[h2]Store name customization[/h2]
Now you can customize your store name. As you level up, you can access impressive new designs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/ab59eda25c7535834e5c0e47b1be959253041c0f.png[/img]

[h2]Radio[/h2]
Some of you liked the music, some of you didn't like it at all. Here is the radio. Now you can change the music. Don't forget to buy it in the store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/e0a0516e23d2ebc9f2694388a340689504d28fc8.png[/img]

[h2]Number of Product Boxes[/h2]

The pizza, hamburger, etc... boxes that we used to make unlimited at first are now in limited quantities. When you run out of boxes, you have to order boxes and fold them again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/f9a223774435045807100146e0ad0831e51c5c95.png[/img]

[h2]New Cup Holders[/h2]
Many people were not satisfied with the current cup holder design. So we changed its design and added 2 new cup holders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/630bdd333c4d9c70076a7bbfedf2d26e84bad114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/86a266cbded7af99f62d713467de17b39bd5af79.png[/img]

[h2]Popcorn[/h2]
Added 4 versions for popcorn machine. You also need to buy and fold a popcorn box to make popcorn. The first price of the machine has been reduced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/2dfbd096b857e2c3b11ce9c3cbc23d8345003759.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/bc0554a18986a1ac09bd5992924dd3f33822a0fc.png[/img]


[h2]Additional Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Automatic cap is added when water is full
[*]Invoice prices have been stabilized.
[*]Reduced the waiting time when switching to object transport mode.
[*]Added helpful tutorials for object placement.
[*]Now you can see which product is inside the folded product boxes
[*]Fridge A , interaction with shelves is facilitated.
[*]For Shelf A object, interaction with shelves is facilitated.
[*]increased running speed
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
Many, many thanks to everyone who reported a bug.

[list]
[*]Interaction during burger box folding is now much easier.
[*]Fixed version of objects in box not saving correctly
[*]Fixed pizza box auto-closing issue
[*]Resolved resetting of settings
[*]Solved the ordering problem for products with size options
[*]Coffee machine button disappearance bug solved
[*]Fixed the same NPC spawn bug
[*]Fixed walking through vehicle bug
[*]Fixed the issue where the object placed in the slot changes when the object is handled again.
[*]Cheesybites pizza position bug fixed.

[/list]


[h1]Streamer Updates:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/9b69c5788a27f772838bc9823b13f43a7a8eb6b1.jpg[/img]
Thank you to all the streamers who tested our game. We are especially happy that you activated the twitch integration. We follow your broadcasts and make all the improvements we can in this regard.

- !help Command added
- List of 20 random products that can be special ordered with the !menu command
- For the !order command, the ability to order the desired products has been added.
- VIP customers now come with money effect.
- Fixed the problem in conversation messages after the real customer.
- Now real customers can object to expensive products.

[h2]Halloween[/h2]
Halloween themed content has been removed except for the coffin shelf.

notes.title: Streamer Update is Here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/9b69c5788a27f772838bc9823b13f43a7a8eb6b1.jpg[/img]
Streamer Updates:
We are trying to watch many streams for get your feedbacks. We noticed that it was difficult to use the twitch integration while watching streams, so we made a series of patches to make it easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/6e6d803a6f6adfbc9a0e40600a4cb7debd3ac315.png[/img]
You can now see the connection status in-game in the bottom band
Ordering is now open to everyone in the chat.
If Bit is sent when ordering, that customer gets priority as a VIP customer.
To prevent abuse, regular customers can have 1 order and VIP customers can have 3 orders at the same time.

Order placement command has been simplified.
Normal Chat Message: !order Message
VIP Chat Message: Any message with bits will take as VIP customer.


Bug Fix
Boxes no longer go into the front shelf
The bug with the first customer has been resolved.
The order after open close has been solved.
Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/1ea435e41a31d78b3b9b36224c8015e309910159.png[/img]
First of all, thanks to all the Thru Thrillers who gave feedback. Please don't forget to leave a steam review to help us out.

[b]Update Notes:[/b]
Support for taking payments with numpad, one of the most requested features, has been added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/1c54973f0919fbdd06a256401dd7c1b6c90f5055.png[/img]


We've heard your complaints about storage space and have made improvements.
A new storage space has been added to the front stand.
Shelf A capacity has been increased from 12 to 27. Also it has 3 level now.
Vertical Display is available for purchase in the store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/fb9b50fe40b5e235423dd48b397a46ec3d2c5779.png[/img]
We heard that boxes are lying around and you want to organize them, so we've added a new item, the Box Stand. You can buy it in the store.


Added halloween special coffin shelf for a limited time. You will love this beautiful stand!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/cf9bf69dd0289374560f60dadf1cbf6eaebe5423.png[/img]


Recycling is important!
You will now be reimbursed for every empty box you throw in the trash.


Added day/night dynamic light cycle.

New NPCs
New Vehicle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124951/96ff96370ce7ccb54e3b1350dedc68c7220b19f2.png[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Coffee machine v3 bug of not being able to put cups has been fixed.
Fixed the bug where NPCs would get nested while walking.
Incoming invoices have been balanced.

[b]Notes:[/b]
We see that there is confusion about the maximum price. As you get closer to the max price from the market price, the selling rate of the products decreases rapidly. Still, some customers may prefer to buy expensive items. Here you can set the price according to your sales strategy.

Halloween surprises...ːsteammockingː ːsteammockingː ːsteammockingː

We value the opinions of our Thru Thrillers community and your contribution to this game is great. Please continue to share your opinions with us.

I hope you get a lot of tips.
Have Fun

notes.title: Demo is Live
notes.notes:
Exciting New Update!

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for our game, packed with fantastic new features and improvements! Here’s what’s new:

🍫 New Kitchen Machines and Shelves: Upgrade your kitchen with the latest state-of-the-art machines and stylish shelves to enhance your cooking experience.


🍰 Dubai Chocolate and Many Desserts: Indulge in the rich flavors of Dubai chocolate and explore a variety of new, mouth-watering desserts that will delight your customers.


🛠️ New Mechanics: Discover innovative gameplay mechanics that add depth and excitement to your culinary adventures.


🐞 Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed those pesky bugs to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.


We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in our prologue and playtest. Your valuable feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update. We couldn’t have done it without you!

Happy cooking!
